findings.detail: December 31 comparative Veristat and Parcelshield rows were added alongside their March 31 rows, inflating the current-quarter count from six to eight.
Kauffman was represented with the December 31 rate of 10.27% rather than the March 31 rate of 10.30%.

rationale: Class 3 period-scope adjudication. The March 31 schedule marks six current instruments with footnote (5): Kauffman (table 16 row 16), two Midwest Vision loans (table 19 rows 24-25), Veristat (table 20 row 25), Parcelshield (table 21 row 18), and AWRG Borrower (table 21 row 22). The eight-row artifact also contains December 31 comparative versions of Veristat (table 48 row 7) and Parcelshield (table 48 row 33), while Kauffman's artifact rate 10.27% comes from comparative table 44 row 10 instead of current table 16 row 16 at 10.30%. Thus the nonaccrual status is source-supported, but the reported count of eight is a comparative-period extraction defect; the current schedule count is six.
